description: This file defines the DefaultPlatformPasswordEncoder class, which implements the PlatformPasswordEncoder interface and provides password encoding functionality for PlatformUser objects using Spring Security's PasswordEncoder.

classes.name: DefaultPlatformPasswordEncoder
classes.description: A service class that encodes passwords for PlatformUser objects using an injected PasswordEncoder.

methods.name: DefaultPlatformPasswordEncoder
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the encoder with a PasswordEncoder instance.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes the password of a given PlatformUser using the injected PasswordEncoder.
